name: Resume an interrupted plugin migration safely
query: Move plugin records to a new schema through scheduled batches. Jobs can overlap, deployments can be interrupted, and retries must not send duplicate customer notifications.
expected_behavior: Run project triage and route to plugin development plus production safety
Inventory every reader, writer, scheduled entry point, notification side effect, and supported runtime version
Use a durable migration version and stable monotonic cursor rather than page offsets
Advance progress only after the batch's durable writes succeed
Make overlapping workers claim or lock work and make retries converge
Separate replay-safe storage from the independently idempotent notification side effect
Preserve a compatible read path while old and new code can overlap
Test interruption before and after progress commits, duplicate jobs, concurrent inserts, and replay
success_criteria: No skipped or duplicate records after interruption and resume
One notification per logical event under duplicate and overlapping delivery
Mixed-version deployment has an explicit compatible read path
Rollback and exhausted-retry behavior are documented and testable
No live customer data or live side effects are used for verification
